attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Renaming/moving several built-in JS asset paths (e.g. TheAdmin.js, theme-manager.js, workflow-*.js) changes public static file URLs referenced via SetUrl/asp-src, which could break custom themes/modules or CDN caches that hardcode or override those script paths even though the in-repo references were updated consistently."}

reason: Renaming/moving several built-in JS asset paths (e.g. TheAdmin.js, theme-manager.js, workflow-*.js) changes public static file URLs referenced via SetUrl/asp-src, which could break custom themes/modules or CDN caches that hardcode or override those script paths even though the in-repo references were updated consistently.
